mechanics.claim: Fury decays 1 per 0.25s after 12s out of combat and not attacking; entering combat or attacking resets the timer.
mechanics.quote: Entering combat or using an attack will stop the {{as|Fury}} loss and refresh the timer.

mechanics.claim: While Dominus (ultimate) is active, the out-of-combat Fury decay timer is continuously refreshed.
mechanics.quote: while ''{{ai|Dominus|Renekton}}'' is active, the timer is continuously refreshed

mechanics.claim: At 50+ Fury, the next basic ability (except Slice and Dice) consumes 50 Fury to become empowered with an additional effect, dealing more damage.
mechanics.quote: his next {{tip|ability|basic ability}}, excluding ''{{ai|Slice and Dice|Renekton|Slice}}'', consumes {{as|50 Fury}} to become empowered with an additional effect

mechanics.claim: Empowered abilities do not generate Fury.
Basic attacks against structures do not generate Fury.
mechanics.quote: Basic attacks against any enemy that is not a structure will generate the Fury.
